C-PORTRAIT: half-length portrait, three-quarter view, centred composition, plain warm cream paper background, subject occupies 70% of frame, 1:1 square
C-BUST: head and shoulders bust, extreme close-up, the face fills the upper two thirds of the frame, frontal three-quarter view, tight crop, vignetted cream paper background, 1:1 square
C-FULL: full length standing figure shown head to toe with the feet fully inside the frame, slight low angle, plain cream paper ground, no furniture or props touching the ground, thin cast shadow only, 2:3 vertical
C-ICON: single isolated object, orthographic three-quarter overhead view, no background, no scene, no ground plane, centred, generous margin, 1:1 square
C-TILE: seamless tileable texture, flat top-down orthographic view, even illumination, no directional shadow, no focal point, uniform density across the whole square, 1:1
C-MAP: top-down orthographic cartographic view, north up, no perspective, even lighting, antique map plate
C-SCENE: narrative illustration, cinematic staging, shallow depth of field suggested by softer pencil pressure in background, 3:2 horizontal
C-SYMBOL: flat cartographic symbol, drawn as if inked onto a military campaign map, isolated on transparent background, no scene, no perspective, 1:1 square
